CloudSync securely backs up and synchronises your connections and settings between all of your devices.

CloudSync is backed by strong AES-256 encryption to protect all of your information. The result is that any synchronised information can only be decrypted with the passphrase you've set.

Neither LimeSSH CloudSync servers, Google or any other potential attacker will ever have the ability to eavesdrop or decrypt your information.

In order to encrypt your information during the synchronisation process an encryption passphrase is required.\n\nYou must use the same passphrase on all of your devices in order for CloudSync to function.
